description: Look up names for the location parameter of webscraping_ai_serp. Returns up to 10 matching locations as JSON, most populous first, each with id, name, canonical_name (pass it as location), country_code, target_type (e.g. City, State, Country), reach (approximate population) and gps ([longitude, latitude]). Matches English names, e.g. petersburg. Free. API docs: https://webscraping.ai/docs#serp-locations

limit.description: Maximum number of locations to return, from 1 to 10 (10 by default).

q.description: Part of a location name, e.g. austin. Without it, the most populous locations are returned.

name: webscraping_ai_serp_locations
title: Look Up Search Locations
